title: Oura Respiratory Rate Drift
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=oura:daily
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(respiratory_rate) as respiratory_rate by person _time
| eventstats avg(respiratory_rate) as baseline by person
| where respiratory_rate>baseline+1.5
| sort - respiratory_rate
description: Uses Oura daily readiness exports telemetry to monitor respiratory-rate movement against the longer baseline in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for breathing changes that may precede illness or poor recovery, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Oura daily readiness exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily respiratory-rate line chart with baseline overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It totals respiratory-rate movement against the longer baseline so you can spot breathing changes that may precede illness or poor recovery before it becomes annoying.
